series.name: MID 15-50KTL3-XL2 / X2 (three-phase commercial string, OLED + touch)
series.notes: GR-UM-247-A-01. IMPORTANT: the same 3-digit codes carry DIFFERENT wording from the MOD 3-15KTL3-X manual (e.g. here Error 200 = 'DC arc abnormal', 201 = 'Leakage current is too high', 202 = 'Panel voltage is too high', 300 = 'The mains voltage is abnormal', 301 = 'AC wiring error', 303 = 'Zero ground detection anomaly', 420 = 'Leakage current module is abnormal', 423 = 'Abnormal battery reverse connection protection tube', 424 = 'Battery voltage sampling is inconsistent'). Never merge this series with MOD 3-15KTL3-X. Codes unique to this body: 203 wording, 410 'Inconsistent insulation resistance sampling', 423, 424, and warnings 200-210/300-307/400-406.

title.en: DC arc abnormal (arcing on PV side)
title.ur: DC arc abnormal (PV side par arcing)

meaning.en: An arc has been detected on the DC / PV side and the unit has locked out.
meaning.ur: DC / PV side par arc detect hua aur unit lock out ho gaya.

causes.en: Arcing at a PV terminal due to a loose or burnt connector
causes.ur: Loose ya burnt connector ki wajah se PV terminal par arcing

causes.en: Damaged module or cable insulation
causes.ur: Module ya cable insulation damaged

solutions.en: Isolate AC and PV, then check the panel terminal wiring after shutdown.
solutions.ur: AC aur PV isolate karke shutdown ke baad panel terminal wiring check karein.

solutions.en: Look for heat discolouration or a burnt smell at every DC terminal and re-crimp it.
solutions.ur: Har DC terminal par garmi ke rang ya burnt smell dekhein aur use dobara crimp karein.

solutions.en: Restart the inverter; if the message persists, contact the manufacturer.
solutions.ur: Inverter restart karein; message bacha rahe to manufacturer se rabta karein.

meaning.en: Measured leakage current is above the permitted level, so the inverter has stopped.
meaning.ur: Measured leakage permitted level se zyada hai, is liye inverter ruk gaya.

causes.en: Array insulation breakdown or a wet junction box
causes.ur: Array insulation breakdown ya geela junction box

causes.en: GFCI module or SPD damaged
causes.ur: GFCI module ya SPD damaged

solutions.en: Isolate PV and AC, then measure insulation resistance to earth with a megohmmeter.
solutions.ur: PV aur AC isolate karke megohmmeter se earth ke taraf insulation resistance measure karein.

solutions.en: Split the array string by string to find the leaking path.
solutions.ur: Array ko string by string baant kar leaking path dhoondein.

solutions.en: Restart the machine; if the fault information persists, contact the manufacturer.
solutions.ur: Machine restart karein; fault information bachi rahe to manufacturer se rabta karein.

meaning.en: PV input voltage is above what the inverter will accept on this body.
meaning.ur: PV input voltage is body par inverter ki sehat se zyada hai.

causes.en: Too many modules per string for the local minimum temperature
causes.ur: Local minimum temperature ke liye string mein modules zyada hain

causes.en: Two strings paralleled in error
causes.ur: Do strings galti se parallel ho gaye

solutions.en: Disconnect the DC switch immediately and confirm the voltage.
solutions.ur: DC switch foran disconnect karke voltage confirm karein.

solutions.en: After the normal voltage is restored, if the message still exists, contact the manufacturer.
solutions.ur: Normal voltage restore hone ke baad bhi message rahe to manufacturer se rabta karein.

solutions.en: Recalculate string length from the module Voc at the coldest expected temperature.
solutions.ur: Sab se thande expected temperature par module Voc se string ki lambai dobara calculate karein.

title.ur: Panel ki insulation resistance kam hai

meaning.en: The PV array insulation resistance to earth is below the required value.
meaning.ur: PV array ki earth ke taraf insulation resistance required value se neeche hai.

causes.en: Damaged module backsheet or cable insulation chafed on the frame
causes.ur: Module backsheet damaged ya cable insulation frame par rub hua

causes.en: Water ingress in the junction box or combiner
causes.ur: Junction box ya combiner mein paani aa gaya

solutions.en: After shutting down, check whether the panel shell is reliably grounded.
solutions.ur: Shutdown ke baad check karein ke panel shell mazboot se grounded hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: Measure insulation resistance per string with a megohmmeter to find the affected string.
solutions.ur: Har string ki insulation resistance megohmmeter se measure karke affected string dhoondein.

solutions.en: Replace the damaged module or cable, and re-test before reconnecting the inverter.
solutions.ur: Damaged module ya cable badlein, aur dobara lagane se pehle dobara test karein.

meaning.en: Grid voltage is abnormal and has not returned to the allowable range.
meaning.ur: Grid voltage abnormal hai aur allowable range mein wapas nahi aayi.

causes.en: Grid sag from a large motor starting, or an upstream fault
causes.ur: Bade motor ki starting se grid sag, ya upstream fault

causes.en: Transformer tap or voltage set-point wrong for the site
causes.ur: Transformer tap ya voltage set-point site ke liye ghalat

solutions.en: Check the grid voltage with a true-RMS meter at the AC terminals.
solutions.ur: AC terminals par true-RMS meter se grid voltage check karein.

solutions.en: If the grid voltage has recovered to the allowable range and the message persists, contact the manufacturer.
solutions.ur: Agar grid voltage allowable range mein wapas aa gayi aur message bacha to manufacturer se rabta karein.

meaning.en: The mains terminal wiring is wrong, so the inverter cannot operate.
meaning.ur: Mains terminal wiring ghalat hai, is liye inverter operate nahi kar sakta.

causes.en: Phase sequence or N/PE conductors wrongly connected
causes.ur: Phase sequence ya N/PE conductors ghalat se lage hain

causes.en: Loose or overheated mains terminal lug
causes.ur: Mains terminal lug loose ya overheated

solutions.en: Isolate AC and PV, then check the mains terminal connections.
solutions.ur: AC aur PV isolate karke mains terminal connections check karein.

solutions.en: Re-torque the mains terminals and check for heat discolouration on the lugs.
solutions.ur: Mains terminals dobara torque karein aur lugs par garmi ke rang dekhein.

solutions.en: If the fault message still exists, contact the manufacturer.
solutions.ur: Agar fault message phir bhi rahe to manufacturer se rabta karein.

meaning.en: The inverter sees no mains input after grid connection checks.
meaning.ur: Grid connection checks ke baad inverter ko koi mains input nahi dikhta.

causes.en: AC breaker open or upstream fuse blown
causes.ur: AC breaker open ya upstream fuse uth gaya

causes.en: AC side line disconnected
causes.ur: AC side line disconnect ho gayi

solutions.en: Check the AC side line connection after shutdown.
solutions.ur: Shutdown ke baad AC side line connection check karein.

solutions.en: Measure grid voltage at the mains terminal to confirm the supply is present.
solutions.ur: Mains terminal par grid voltage measure karke confirm karein ke supply mojood hai.

solutions.en: If the fault message still exists, contact the manufacturer.
solutions.ur: Agar fault message phir bhi rahe to manufacturer se rabta karein.

title.ur: Zero ground detection anomaly - zameen fault

meaning.en: The earth / ground loop has been disturbed, so the zero-ground detection circuit has flagged it.
meaning.ur: Earth / ground loop bigda hua hai, is liye zero-ground detection circuit ne ise flag kiya.

causes.en: Ground wire not connected reliably between inverter and earth
causes.ur: Inverter aur earth ke darmiyan ground wire mazboot se nahi lagi

causes.en: N-PE impedance out of limit in the distribution board
causes.ur: Distribution board mein N-PE impedance limit se bahar

solutions.en: Check the ground wire after shutting down to ensure it is connected reliably.
solutions.ur: Shutdown ke baad ground wire check karein ke mazboot se lagi hai.

solutions.en: Measure earth continuity and the N-to-PE voltage with a multimeter.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se earth continuity aur N se PE voltage measure karein.

solutions.en: If the fault message still exists, contact the manufacturer.
solutions.ur: Agar fault message phir bhi rahe to manufacturer se rabta karein.

meaning.en: Grid frequency is outside the specified range.
meaning.ur: Grid frequency specified range se bahar hai.

causes.en: Generator supply with a drifting frequency
causes.ur: Generator supply jis ki frequency drift kar rahi ho

causes.en: Weak grid with frequency swings
causes.ur: Kamzor grid jismein frequency swing karti hai

solutions.en: Detect the grid frequency with a meter and restart the inverter.
solutions.ur: Meter se grid frequency detect karke inverter restart karein.

solutions.en: If the frequency is within range and the message persists, contact the manufacturer.
solutions.ur: Agar frequency range mein hai aur message bacha rahe to manufacturer se rabta karein.

meaning.en: Output load exceeded the inverter rating and the overload protection shut it down.
meaning.ur: Output load inverter rating se cross kar gaya aur overload protection ne band kar diya.

causes.en: Connected load above the inverter rated power
causes.ur: Connected load inverter rated power se zyada hai

causes.en: Load step or motor inrush on start
causes.ur: Load step ya start par motor ka inrush

solutions.en: Check the output load and reduce the load power.
solutions.ur: Output load check karke load power kam karein.

solutions.en: Measure actual per-phase current with a clamp meter to confirm which leg is overloaded.
solutions.ur: Clamp meter se asal per-phase current measure karke confirm karein kaun sa leg overloaded hai.

solutions.en: If the fault information persists, contact the manufacturer.
solutions.ur: Agar fault information bachi rahe to manufacturer se rabta karein.

meaning.en: The insulation-resistance measurement channels disagree, so the result is not trusted.
meaning.ur: Insulation-resistance measurement channels aapas mein match nahi karte, is liye result par bharosa nahi.

causes.en: Insulation detection circuit drifted, often after moisture
causes.ur: Insulation detection circuit bekar chala hai, aksar nam ke baad

causes.en: Loose connector on the insulation measurement board
causes.ur: Insulation measurement board par connector loose

solutions.en: Restart the machine and note whether the fault is consistent or intermittent.
solutions.ur: Machine restart karke note karein ke fault consistent hai ya intermittent.

solutions.en: Isolate AC and PV, then use an external megohmmeter to get a true insulation reading.
solutions.ur: AC aur PV isolate karke bahar ke megohmmeter se asal insulation reading lein.

solutions.en: If the external reading is good but the code stays, the internal circuit needs replacing - contact the manufacturer.
solutions.ur: Agar bahar ki reading theek hai aur code bacha rahe to internal circuit badalna parega - manufacturer se rabta karein.

meaning.en: The low-voltage auxiliary supply feeding the control electronics is out of specification.
meaning.ur: Control electronics ko chalane wali low-voltage auxiliary supply specification se bahar hai.

causes.en: Auxiliary SMPS failing on the control board
causes.ur: Control board par auxiliary SMPS fail ho raha hai

causes.en: Fuse or supply rail opened after a surge event
causes.ur: Surge event ke baad fuse ya supply rail khul gaya

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery, then wait 5 minutes for the bus to discharge.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery isolate karke 5 minute wait karein taake bus discharge ho.

solutions.en: Restart the machine; if the fault persists, contact the manufacturer.
solutions.ur: Machine restart karein; fault bacha rahe to manufacturer se rabta karein.

aliases: Abnormal battery reverse connection protection tube

title.ur: Battery reverse-connection protection tube abnormal hai

meaning.en: The reverse-polarity protection device in the battery connection has failed or tripped abnormally.
meaning.ur: Battery connection ka reverse-polarity protection device fail ya abnormal trigger hua.

causes.en: Battery connected with reversed polarity, blowing the protection device
causes.ur: Battery reversed polarity se lagi aur protection device uth gaya

causes.en: Protection fuse/relay stuck or failed without a real polarity error
causes.ur: Asal polarity error ke baghair protection fuse/relay jam ya fail

solutions.en: Isolate the battery completely, then check polarity with a multimeter on the battery cable ends.
solutions.ur: Battery poori tarah isolate karke multimeter se battery cable ends par polarity check karein.

solutions.en: Confirm BAT+ and BAT- match the inverter marking before reconnecting anything.
solutions.ur: Kuch bhi dobara lagane se pehle confirm karein ke BAT+ aur BAT- inverter ke marking se match karte hain.

solutions.en: Restart the machine; if the fault message still exists, contact the manufacturer.
solutions.ur: Machine restart karein; fault message phir bhi rahe to manufacturer se rabta karein.

meaning.en: The two battery-voltage measurement paths disagree, so the reading is not trusted.
meaning.ur: Do battery-voltage measurement paths aapas mein match nahi karte, is liye reading par bharosa nahi.

causes.en: Voltage sense wire loose or corroded at the battery terminal
causes.ur: Battery terminal par voltage sense wire loose ya corroded

causes.en: Sampling divider or reference drifted on the board
causes.ur: Board par sampling divider ya reference bekar chala hai

solutions.en: Isolate the battery and reseat the voltage sense wires at both the battery and the inverter.
solutions.ur: Battery isolate karke voltage sense wires battery aur inverter dono taraf dobara baithayein.

solutions.en: Measure battery voltage with a multimeter and compare it against the app reading.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se battery voltage measure karke app reading se compare karein.

solutions.en: If the paths never agree, the control board sensing circuit must be replaced - contact the manufacturer.
solutions.ur: Agar paths kabhi match na hon to control board ka sensing circuit badalna parega - manufacturer se rabta karein.

meaning.en: The cooling fan is not working, so the inverter derates instead of stopping.
meaning.ur: Cooling fan kaam nahi kar raha, is liye inverter band hone ke bajaye power kam karta hai.

causes.en: Fan connector loose after shutdown work
causes.ur: Shutdown kaam ke baad fan connector loose

causes.en: Fan motor failed or blades blocked
causes.ur: Fan motor fail ya blades block

solutions.en: Check the fan wiring after shutdown and reseat the connector.
solutions.ur: Shutdown ke baad fan wiring check karke connector dobara baithayein.

solutions.en: Spin the fan by hand to confirm it turns freely, then check for dust on the blades.
solutions.ur: Fan ko haath se ghumakar confirm karein ke azaad ghoomta hai, phir blades par dhool dekhein.

solutions.en: Replace the fan if it is seized or noisy.
solutions.ur: Fan jam ho ya shor kare to use badal dein.

meaning.en: Panel input voltage is above the set limit; output is restricted until it comes back.
meaning.ur: Panel input voltage set limit se upar hai; wapas aane tak output restricted rahega.

causes.en: Cold weather raising string Voc above the threshold
causes.ur: Thande mausam se string ka Voc threshold se upar chala gaya

causes.en: Upper voltage threshold set too low
causes.ur: Upper voltage threshold bohat kam set hai

solutions.en: Disconnect the DC switch immediately and confirm the voltage.
solutions.ur: DC switch foran disconnect karke voltage confirm karein.

solutions.en: Check the panel input and count the modules against the string Voc calculation.
solutions.ur: Panel input check karke string Voc calculation ke against modules gin lein.

solutions.en: After the normal voltage is restored, if the message persists, contact the manufacturer.
solutions.ur: Normal voltage restore hone ke baad bhi message rahe to manufacturer se rabta karein.

title.ur: Current transformer open hai / connected nahi

meaning.en: The inverter gets no current-transformer signal, so it cannot do export limiting.
meaning.ur: Inverter ko current-transformer ka signal nahi mil raha, is liye export limiting nahi kar sakta.

causes.en: CT secondary lead not connected or CT not clipped onto the conductor
causes.ur: CT secondary lead nahi lagi ya CT conductor par nahi laga

causes.en: RS485 link to the CT/meter broken
causes.ur: CT/meter ka RS485 link toota hua

solutions.en: After shutdown, check whether the current transformer is connected well.
solutions.ur: Shutdown ke baad check karein ke current transformer theek se laga hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: Confirm the CT arrow faces the load and S1/S2 go to the right meter terminals.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke CT ka arrow load ki taraf hai aur S1/S2 sahi meter terminals par lage hain.

solutions.en: If the message persists, contact the manufacturer.
solutions.ur: Agar message bacha rahe to manufacturer se rabta karein.

title.en: Control board and comm board firmware mismatch (warning 405)
title.ur: Control board aur comm board firmware mismatch (warning 405)

meaning.en: The control board and the communication board are running different firmware releases.
meaning.ur: Control board aur communication board alag alag firmware releases par chal rahe hain.

causes.en: A partial firmware update left the two boards on different versions
causes.ur: Partial firmware update ki wajah se dono boards alag versions par reh gaye

causes.en: Comm board replaced without matching firmware
causes.ur: Comm board badla gaya aur matching firmware nahi lagaya

solutions.en: Check the firmware version of both boards and record them.
solutions.ur: Dono boards ka firmware version check karke note karein.

solutions.en: Update both boards to the same released firmware pair from the Growatt download centre.
solutions.ur: Dono boards ko Growatt download centre se ek hi released firmware pair par update karein.

solutions.en: If the message persists, contact the manufacturer.
solutions.ur: Agar message bacha rahe to manufacturer se rabta karein.
